programs.name: accumulator, 100000 deep
programs.source: (define (sum n acc) (if (= n 0) acc (sum (- n 1) (+ acc n)))) (display (sum 100000 0))

programs.name: mutual
programs.source: (define (ev? n) (if (= n 0) #t (od? (- n 1)))) (define (od? n) (if (= n 0) #f (ev? (- n 1)))) (display (ev? 100000))

programs.name: side effects in a loop
programs.source: (define count 0) (define (loop n) (if (> n 0) (begin (set! count (+ count 1)) (loop (- n 1))))) (loop 100000) (display count)

programs.name: through a lambda
programs.source: (define (loop n acc) (if (= n 0) acc ((lambda (m) (loop m (+ acc 1))) (- n 1)))) (display (loop 100000 0))
